---
title: "Case Study: The Eagles — Trenches, RPOs, and the Tush Push"
subtitle: "How Philadelphia built three Super Bowl teams around the lines of scrimmage, and what the data says about its most famous yard"
description: "The Philadelphia Eagles from 2017 to 2026 as one long experiment in building through the trenches: Doug Pederson's 2017 RPO offense and the Philly Special; Nick Sirianni's pivot to a run game built on Jalen Hurts's legs and Jeff Stoutland's offensive line; the coordinator churn that followed; the tush push measured honestly as an Eagles-minus-league delta; the 2024 champions, Saquon Barkley and Vic Fangio's four-man rush in Super Bowl LIX; and how roster building made the scheme possible."
glossary:
  "Philly Special": "The trick play the Eagles ran for a touchdown on fourth-and-goal in Super Bowl LII (February 2018): the quarterback walks up behind the line as if changing the play, the ball is snapped directly to the running back, who pitches it to a tight end on a reverse, and the tight end throws to the quarterback, who has slipped uncovered into the end zone."

```{python}
#| code-summary: "Show the Python (shared drawing helpers for this chapter)"
#| output: false
import os
import logging
import shutil

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib import animation
from matplotlib.patches import Ellipse, FancyArrowPatch, Patch
from matplotlib.lines import Line2D

from gridiron import Play, Player, Field, style, draw_marker

logging.getLogger("matplotlib.font_manager").setLevel(logging.ERROR)
style.apply()
PDF = os.environ.get("RTG_FORMAT", "").lower() in ("pdf", "typst", "print")
READ_GREEN = "#0f7a55"           # darker step of the aqua highlight, for text and read lines
OD, DD = style.OFFENSE_DARK, style.DEFENSE_DARK
LINE_D, OFF_BALL, GUN, PISTOL = -0.7, -1.5, -5.0, -4.0


def opp(n):
    """Line of scrimmage (BDB x) for a ball on the opponent's n-yard line. The goal line is x = 110."""
    return 110 - n


def own(n):
    """Line of scrimmage (BDB x) for a ball on the offense's own n-yard line."""
    return 10 + n


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- players and alignments
def O(key, pos, d, w, label=None):
    return Player(key, pos, "off", d, w, label=key if label is None else label)


def D(key, pos, d, w, label):
    return Player(key, pos, "def", d, w, label=label)


def line5(split=1.6, d=LINE_D):
    """Five offensive linemen; only the center is lettered."""
    return [O(k, k, d, m * split, "C" if k == "C" else "") for k, m in
            (("LT", -2), ("LG", -1), ("C", 0), ("RG", 1), ("RT", 2))]


def dline(w=(-5.4, -0.8, 2.4, 5.4), d=1.0):
    return [D("WDE", "DE", d, w[0], "E"), D("WDT", "DT", d, w[1], "T"),
            D("SDT", "DT", d, w[2], "T"), D("SDE", "DE", d, w[3], "E")]


def move_to(p, key, *pts, kind="block", delay=0.0, speed=None):
    """Move `key` through absolute (d, w) points as a block, rush, run or path."""
    start = np.array(p._cur(key))
    rel = [tuple(np.array(q) - start) for q in pts]
    if kind == "block":
        return p.block(key, pts=rel, delay=delay, speed=speed)
    if kind == "rush":
        return p.rush(key, pts=rel, delay=delay, speed=speed)
    return {"path": p.path, "run": p.run}[kind](key, rel, delay=delay, speed=speed)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- drawing helpers
def P(fld, p, d, w):
    return fld.xy(*p.to_abs(d, w))


def clean(ax, numbers=False):
    """Drop the painted yard numbers unless asked (they sit where receivers stand); clip all text."""
    for t in list(ax.texts):
        if not numbers and t.get_text().isdigit() and t.get_alpha() == 0.55:
            t.remove()
        else:
            t.set_clip_on(True)


def draw(p, width_in=6.0, ax=None, numbers=False, **kw):
    fld = p.draw(width_in=width_in, ax=ax, title=False, **kw)
    clean(fld.ax, numbers)
    return fld


def say(fld, p, d, w, text, color=style.INK_2, fontsize=7.0, ha="center", weight="normal", box=True):
    x, y = P(fld, p, d, w)
    fld.ax.text(float(x), float(y), text, fontsize=fontsize, color=color, ha=ha, va="center", zorder=13,
                fontweight=weight, linespacing=1.15,
                bbox=dict(boxstyle="round,pad=0.18", fc=style.SURFACE, ec="none", alpha=0.9) if box else None)


def point_to(fld, p, text_at, target, text, color=style.INK_2, fontsize=7.0, ha="center"):
    (xt, yt), (xp, yp) = P(fld, p, *text_at), P(fld, p, *target)
    fld.ax.annotate(text, (float(xp), float(yp)), xytext=(float(xt), float(yt)), fontsize=fontsize,
                    color=color, ha=ha, va="center", zorder=13, linespacing=1.15,
                    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="-", color=color, lw=0.7, shrinkA=2, shrinkB=7),
                    bbox=dict(boxstyle="round,pad=0.18", fc=style.SURFACE, ec="none", alpha=0.9))


def branch(fld, p, pts, color=style.DEFENSE, lw=1.5, dash=(0, (3, 2.2)), end="arrow", z=5):
    """A path through absolute (d, w) points: by default a defender's reaction (orange dashes)."""
    xs, ys = P(fld, p, np.array([q[0] for q in pts]), np.array([q[1] for q in pts]))
    fld.ax.plot(xs, ys, color=color, lw=lw, ls=dash, zorder=z, solid_capstyle="round")
    if end == "arrow":
        fld.ax.add_patch(FancyArrowPatch((xs[-2], ys[-2]), (xs[-1], ys[-1]), arrowstyle="-|>",
                                         mutation_scale=10, color=color, lw=lw, zorder=z))
    elif end == "bar":
        v = np.array([xs[-1] - xs[-2], ys[-1] - ys[-2]])
        n = np.linalg.norm(v)
        if n > 0:
            q = np.array([-v[1], v[0]]) / n * 0.7
            fld.ax.plot([xs[-1] - q[0], xs[-1] + q[0]], [ys[-1] - q[1], ys[-1] + q[1]], color=color,
                        lw=lw + 0.6, zorder=z)


def oval(fld, p, center, size, color=style.DEFENSE, label=None, alpha=0.13, fs=7.0, ls=(0, (3, 2))):
    """A shaded area (depth, width) with an optional italic label at its centre."""
    x, y = P(fld, p, *center)
    fld.ax.add_patch(Ellipse((float(x), float(y)), size[1], size[0], fc=color, alpha=alpha, ec=color, lw=0.9,
                             ls=ls, zorder=1.6))
    if label:
        fld.ax.text(float(x), float(y), label, ha="center", va="center", fontsize=fs, color=style.INK_2,
                    style="italic", zorder=3)


def panel_title(ax, text, fs=8.6):
    ax.set_title(text, fontsize=fs, loc="left", color=style.INK, fontweight="bold")


def under_note(ax, text, fs=6.9):
    ax.text(0.5, -0.02, text, transform=ax.transAxes, ha="center", va="top", fontsize=fs, color=style.INK,
            linespacing=1.2)


LEGEND = {
    "route": Line2D([], [], color=style.OFFENSE, lw=1.8, label="route"),
    "carrier": Line2D([], [], color=style.OFFENSE_DARK, lw=2.6, label="ball carrier"),
    "block": Line2D([], [], color=style.OFFENSE_DARK, lw=1.8, marker="|", ms=7, label="block"),
    "react": Line2D([], [], color=style.DEFENSE, lw=1.4, ls=(0, (3, 2.2)), label="defender's path"),
    "rush": Line2D([], [], color=style.DEFENSE, lw=1.8, label="pass rusher"),
    "drop": Line2D([], [], color=style.DEFENSE, lw=1.3, ls=(0, (3, 2)), label="zone drop"),
    "ring": Line2D([], [], marker="o", ls="", ms=11, mfc="none", mec=style.THIRD, mew=2, label="player to watch"),
    "area": Patch(fc=style.DEFENSE, alpha=0.2, ec=style.DEFENSE, label="zone a defender guards"),
    "double": Patch(fc=style.THIRD, alpha=0.25, ec=style.THIRD, label="double team"),
    "climb": Line2D([], [], color=READ_GREEN, lw=1.4, ls=(0, (3, 2.2)), label="climb to a linebacker"),
    "option": Line2D([], [], color=style.OFFENSE_DARK, lw=1.4, ls=(0, (3, 2.2)), label="the back's options"),
    "ltg": Line2D([], [], color=style.LINE_TO_GAIN, lw=2.2, label="line to gain"),
}


def field_legend(ax, keys, fs=7.0, ncol=None, y=0.0):
    hs = [LEGEND[k] for k in keys]
    ax.legend(handles=hs, loc="upper center", bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, y), ncol=ncol or min(len(hs), 4),
              fontsize=fs, frameon=False, handlelength=2.0, columnspacing=1.2, borderaxespad=0.2)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- motion: keyframes, frame strips, video
def set_tracks(p, tracks, t_first=-2.6):
    """Hand-made keyframes {key: [(t, d, w), ...]} that may start before the snap. Every listed player
    starts at his alignment at t_first; players not listed stand still. The Philly Special is a play of
    pitches and fakes that gridiron's routes can't time, so every moving body is keyframed by hand."""
    kf, _, t1 = p._compile()
    kf = dict(kf)
    for key, rows in tracks.items():
        q = p.players[key]
        kf[key] = np.array([(t_first, q.d, q.w)] + [tuple(r_) for r_ in rows], dtype=float)
    p._compiled = (kf, t_first, max(t1, *[rows[-1][0] for rows in tracks.values()]))


def ease(points, step=0.05):
    """Smooth keyframes through (t, d, w) waypoints (ease in and out on each leg)."""
    rows = []
    for (ta, da, wa), (tb, db, wb) in zip(points[:-1], points[1:]):
        for tt in np.arange(ta, tb, step):
            f = (tt - ta) / (tb - ta)
            f = f * f * (3 - 2 * f)
            rows.append((round(float(tt), 3), da + (db - da) * f, wa + (wb - wa) * f))
    rows.append(tuple(points[-1]))
    return rows


def frame(ax, p, t, lateral, window, rings=(), ltg=True, numbers=False, mr=0.75):
    """Everyone at time t (negative = before the snap), with faint trails of where they have been
    since the snap."""
    ylo, yhi = sorted((p.ball_y - lateral[0], p.ball_y - lateral[1]))
    fld = Field(ax=ax, orient="vertical", los=p.los, window=window, numbers=numbers, lateral=(ylo, yhi),
                to_go=p.to_go if ltg else None)
    ppy = fld.pts_per_yard()
    wl, wr = sorted(lateral)
    ring = dict(rings)
    for k, q in p.players.items():
        d, w = p.position(k, t)
        if not (window[0] + 0.4 < d < window[1] - 0.4 and wl + 0.4 < w < wr - 0.4):
            continue
        if t > 0:
            pts = np.array([p.position(k, tt) for tt in np.linspace(0.0, t, 40)])
            if np.ptp(pts[:, 0]) + np.ptp(pts[:, 1]) > 0.3:
                xs, ys = P(fld, p, pts[:, 0], pts[:, 1])
                ax.plot(xs, ys, color=style.OFFENSE if q.side == "off" else style.DEFENSE, lw=1.0,
                        alpha=0.5, zorder=3)
        x, y = P(fld, p, d, w)
        draw_marker(ax, float(x), float(y), q.side, q.label, ppy, ring=ring.get(k), r=mr)
    clean(ax, numbers)
    return fld


def strip_grid(p, times, notes, lateral, window, rings=(), ncols=2, width_in=6.5, deco=None, fs=6.9, ltg=True,
               mr=0.75):
    """Print stand-in for an animation: numbered panels, each with a sentence underneath."""
    nrows = int(np.ceil(len(times) / ncols))
    pw = width_in / ncols
    ph = pw * (window[1] - window[0]) / abs(lateral[1] - lateral[0])
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(nrows, ncols, squeeze=False, figsize=(width_in, nrows * (ph + 0.8)))
    for ax in axes.flat[len(times):]:
        ax.axis("off")
    for i, (ax, t) in enumerate(zip(axes.flat, times)):
        fld = frame(ax, p, t, lateral, window, rings, ltg=ltg, mr=mr)
        if deco:
            deco(t, fld, p)
        lab = "before the snap" if t < -1e-6 else ("snap" if abs(t) < 1e-6 else f"+{t:.1f} s")
        panel_title(ax, f"{i + 1}.  {lab}")
        under_note(ax, notes[i], fs=fs)
    fig.tight_layout(h_pad=3.2, w_pad=0.8)
    return fig


def video(p, lateral, window, t_end, rings=(), width_in=5.6, t_start=-0.4, notes=None, times=None, ltg=True,
          mr=0.75, deco=None):
    """Web version of a strip: the same frame drawn every tenth of a second (pre-snap frames
    included), with the strip's notes as a running caption."""
    from IPython.display import HTML, display
    span_w, span_d = abs(lateral[1] - lateral[0]), window[1] - window[0]
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(width_in, width_in * span_d / span_w + 0.5))
    ts = np.round(np.arange(t_start, t_end + 1e-9, 0.1), 2)

    def update(i):
        ax.clear()
        t = float(ts[i])
        fld = frame(ax, p, t, lateral, window, rings, ltg=ltg, mr=mr)
        if deco:
            deco(t, fld, p)
        txt = "before the snap" if t < -1e-6 else ("snap" if abs(t) < 1e-6 else f"+{t:.1f} s")
        if notes and times:
            cur = [n for tt, n in zip(times, notes) if tt <= t + 1e-6]
            if cur:
                txt += "   " + cur[-1].replace("\n", " ")
        ax.set_title(txt, fontsize=8, loc="left", color=style.INK)
        return []

    fig.tight_layout()
    anim = animation.FuncAnimation(fig, update, frames=len(ts), interval=100, blit=False)
    html = (anim.to_html5_video(embed_limit=40).replace("<video ", '<video style="max-width:100%;height:auto" ')
            if shutil.which("ffmpeg") else anim.to_jshtml(default_mode="once"))
    plt.close(fig)
    display(HTML(html))


def pct(x, nd=0):
    return f"{100 * x:.{nd}f}%"


def pts_(x):
    """A difference in rates as signed percentage points: +14 points, −3 points."""
    v = round(100 * x)
    return f"{'+' if v > 0 else ('−' if v < 0 else '')}{abs(v)} points"


def nth(n):
    n = int(round(n))
    return f"{n}{'th' if 10 <= n % 100 <= 20 else {1: 'st', 2: 'nd', 3: 'rd'}.get(n % 10, 'th')}"
```
